mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Server - Tool Listener - Highest Churn
mcp:tool-listener.name: get-customer-details-with-highest-churn-score
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description:
Retrieve the top N Salesforce customer accounts with the highest Churn Scores.
The "num" parameter specifies the maximum number of customers to return. For example, if num is 5, the tool returns the 5 customers with the highest Churn Scores.
Customers are ordered by Churn Score in descending order, so the customer with the highest Churn Score appears first.
The response always contains the available customer records in a table format with the following columns: Customer ID, Customer Name, Account Number, Email, Joined Date, Tenure (Years), Valid Till, Last Billing Date, Total Revenue, Autopay Enabled, Contact Preference, Churn Score, and Churn Risk Level.
Only Salesforce Account records with an Account Number starting with "ACC" are included.
If fewer than the requested number of customers are available, all available matching customers are returned.

logger.doc:name: Log - Request Received
logger.message: #["[get-customer-details-with-highest-churn-score-flow] Tool invoked - num: " ++ (payload.num as String default "null")]

salesforce:query.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT Id, Name, AccountNumber, Email__c, Joined_on__c, tenure_year__c, Valid_Till__c, Last_Billing_Date__c, Total_Revenue__c, Autopay_Enabled__c, Contact_Preferances__c, Churn_Score__c, Churn_Risk_Level__c FROM Account WHERE AccountNumber LIKE 'ACC%' ORDER BY Churn_Score__c DESC LIMIT :num

logger.doc:name: Log - Query Result
logger.message: #["[get-customer-details-with-highest-churn-score-flow] Salesforce query returned " ++ (sizeOf(payload) as String) ++ " records"]
